bio: Wanted on every continent, with an unpaid tab in every bar and a lover in every port, Sabado is the example if you looked up "Freeborn" in an Amaran dictionary. He's a capo in Vakia's mafia, known for providing "protection" for non-Freeborn ships in Freeport's main harbor. If you haven't paid your dues, expect an unmistakable set of burning bullet holes in the side of your ship.
